EventChannel.once(string eventName,function fn)

Listen to an event once, and it will expire after it is triggered.

Parameter

string eventName

Event name

function fn

Event listening function

Parameter

any args

Event triggering parameter

Sample Code

Page({
  onLoad() {
    const eventChannel = this.getOpenerEventChannel();
    eventChannel.once('MacleA', data => {
      console.log(data);
    });
  }
});
